brief:
A wall collapsed on a tent housing a displaced family in Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, injuring three Palestinians, al-Awda hospital sources told Al Jazeera. The incident occurred as hundreds of thousands remain displaced across the enclave amid ongoing conflict.

The three injured were taken to the hospital for treatment. Details on the severity of injuries and identities of the victims were not immediately available.

title: Wall collapse injures three displaced Palestinians in Gaza camp
